name: Garmin Venu 3 Smartwatch
description: The Garmin Venu 3 is a smartwatch designed for fitness tracking and everyday use. It offers heart rate monitoring, sleep tracking, GPS, workout tracking, health insights, and a bright AMOLED display. It is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and people interested in tracking their daily activity, workouts, and health information.

features.name: Health & Fitness Tracking
features.explanation: Comprehensive biometric monitoring including heart rate, sleep, and activity tracking.

features.name: High-Clarity Display
features.explanation: Vibrant, high-contrast display designed for clear indoor and outdoor visibility.
